$comment: STAND-IN for a registry bump, delete when carbon-core 3.0.1#7 lands there. The registry's carbon-core (3.0.1#6, ccpshanghai/core 275603a7) verbatim plus one patch: CcpMacros.h's BLUEIMPORT grants default visibility on every GCC/Clang target, not only __APPLE__. Without it Android's blue.so exports none of blue's own API (built under CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden), and _trinity_vulkan.so cannot link: undefined BeOS, BeResMan, BlueAsyncRes::* ... The same change is committed on ccpshanghai/core branch m6-android-blue-exports; once it is pushed and the registry's port moves its REF there as 3.0.1#7, this overlay is redundant and must go. Overlay ports take precedence regardless of version; port-version 7 here so the package differs from the registry's 3.0.1#6 in name and ABI hash, which is what makes blue and every other carbon-* dependent rebuild against it.
name: carbon-core
description: Provides generic low-level functionality and cross-platform abstractions for system calls
